summary: POMDOCTOR Limited, a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer trading on Nasdaq, filed a 6-K reporting the results of its September 30, 2026 extraordinary general meeting. Shareholders approved, on a non-binding advisory basis, termination of the company's American Depositary Receipt program and the related deposit agreement, with a simultaneous direct listing of Class A ordinary shares on Nasdaq (US equivalent: ADR program termination and underlying-share listing). Holders of 12,229,680 Class A and 2,042,042 Class B shares were present, satisfying quorum. A companion 10-to-1 share consolidation passed with 45,387,346 votes for. No price, premium, or board recommendation was stated. Watch ADR conversion mechanics, the direct-listing registration/corporate-action timeline, and potential forced selling by ADR holders unable or unwilling to hold ordinary shares.
